warnings: ONE SECTION COVERS THREE MARKS. The drawing is a single typical section whose dimensions are given as a three-line table beside it (F1 = .20 / F1.5 = .25 / F1.8 = .30 for thickness, F 1 = 1.0 x 1.0 / F 1.5 = 1.5 x 1.5 / F 1.8 = 1.8 x 1.8 for plan size, and the three rebar lines). It is recorded as three separate footing elements rather than one, so each mark's spec can be joined to the plan by element_id per §7.

THE PLAN LABELS AND THE SECTION LABELS DISAGREE SLIGHTLY IN SPELLING, AND BOTH ARE KEPT. The plan writes F 1.5 / F 1.8 with a space; the rebar table writes F 1.0 for the mark the plan calls F 1. element_id follows the plan mark (F1 / F1.5 / F1.8) and every printed variant is preserved in printed_as.

Ø IS RECORDED AS type RB THROUGHOUT, PER §6 - the printed symbol governs and the symbol drawn is Ø, never a ribbed bar. Note this sits against the sheet notes on S-01, which say ขนาด ø 12มม.ขึ้นไปใช้ SD-30 (a deformed grade). The two are not reconciled here on purpose: §6 says go by the printed symbol only and never infer from diameter, so the symbol is recorded as drawn and the note's grade is recorded on S-01's own file as a project-level design criterion.

The two-way mat counts are printed as 6+6 / 8+8 / 10+10. Per §0.5 count carries the sum (12 / 16 / 20) and the printed text is kept in count_printed_as. They are bottom mats only - the section shows one layer of bars near the bottom face with hooked ends, no top mat.

PEDESTAL REINFORCEMENT IS DELIBERATELY LEFT UNQUANTIFIED. The section draws the pedestal cage but prints no bar count or tie spacing for it. Counting bars off a 1:25 reduced scan would be inventing data; the pedestal spec belongs to S-03 (แบบขยายการเสริมเหล็ก ฐานราก, ตอม่อ, เสา, พื้น).

หมายเหตุ printed at the bottom of the sheet, verbatim: หากดินมีกำลังแบกทาน (BEARING CAPACITY) ไม่น้อยกว่า 8 ตัน/ตร.ม. ให้ใช้ฐานรากตามแบบรายละเอียดโดยไม่ต้องใช้เสาเข็มได้. This is the condition that selects this sheet over S-01's pile foundation.
